scope: Additional finding from complete master analysis at eadab28c8bbfb9f7894babb1e4a72237b7911d77, run 41661877755; not part of the historical 266-alert baseline.

findings.evidence: Overlapping whitespace and label matches in a cron header can retry quadratically on malformed tab runs. Parse the first closing bracket and first whitespace separator once, preserving identifier requirements, whitespace/underscore normalization and the existing 64-character label cap. Regression cases cover 100,000 tabs with no bracket, whitespace-only labels and valid long separators, plus Unicode whitespace and malformed identifiers. Tests run only against synthetic strings, not live agent sessions.

validation.quickGateOutcome: All applicable gates pass. The full quick run passed product tests but its design-lint step selected system Bash 3; rerunning only that step with /opt/homebrew/bin first passed. Changed-area verification then passed sequentially under the same PATH.
validation.limitations: The initial restricted-sandbox attempts could not access Swift module cache or loopback test HTTP and are not counted as passes. No real daemon/device or live credential was used.
